---
title: "Quality of life — primary-analysis decision"
subtitle: "Apply the prespecified overall-survival RMST rule"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

The SAP makes the QoL primary analysis conditional on the 66% credible interval
for the 182-day overall-survival RMST difference. The principal-stratum analysis
is primary only when that entire interval lies within the prespecified
equivalence interval of -7 to 7 days. Otherwise, the adjusted death-inclusive
six-month ordinal analysis is primary.

```{r}
#| label: select-qol-primary-analysis
#| include: false

rmst_path <- here::here(
  "results", "primary", "overall-survival", "rmst-summary.parquet"
)
decision_path <- here::here(
  "results", "primary", "overall-survival", "qol-decision.yml"
)

if (!file.exists(rmst_path)) {
  stop("The OS RMST summary must be available before selecting the QoL primary analysis.")
}

rmst <- arrow::read_parquet(rmst_path) |>
  as.data.frame()
required <- c("ci_66_low", "ci_66_high", "rope_low", "rope_high")
if (nrow(rmst) != 1L || !all(required %in% names(rmst))) {
  stop("The OS RMST summary does not contain the prespecified QoL decision inputs.")
}

equivalent <- is.finite(rmst$ci_66_low) && is.finite(rmst$ci_66_high) &&
  rmst$ci_66_low >= rmst$rope_low && rmst$ci_66_high <= rmst$rope_high
primary <- if (equivalent) "principal_stratum" else "death_inclusive_ordinal"
reason <- if (equivalent) {
  "The entire 66% credible interval for the 182-day OS RMST difference lies within -7 to 7 days."
} else {
  "The 66% credible interval for the 182-day OS RMST difference is not entirely within -7 to 7 days."
}

decision <- list(
  status = "available",
  primary_analysis = primary,
  supporting_analysis = if (equivalent) {
    "adjusted death-inclusive six-month ordinal QoL"
  } else {
    "principal-stratum and death-inclusive longitudinal Markov QoL"
  },
  reason = reason,
  ci_66_low = unname(rmst$ci_66_low),
  ci_66_high = unname(rmst$ci_66_high),
  equivalence_low = unname(rmst$rope_low),
  equivalence_high = unname(rmst$rope_high)
)
dir.create(dirname(decision_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines(yaml::as.yaml(decision), decision_path)

if (!identical(primary, "death_inclusive_ordinal")) {
  stop(
    "The OS rule selected the principal-stratum analysis. The currently activated ",
    "primary QoL stages implement the death-inclusive fallback and must not be run."
  )
}
```
